description: This file defines the main UI component for a React-based roadmap journey page, including interactive visualizations like mind map and pathway milestones, as well as utility functions and mock data generation for a career navigation app.

classes.name: RoadmapTab
classes.description: Union type for different roadmap tab states, either 'mindMap' or 'pathway'.

classes.name: SkillDelta
classes.description: Represents an improvement target for a skill with current and target levels.

classes.name: MilestoneStatus
classes.description: Union type indicating the status of a milestone.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Represents a career milestone with fields for title, description, date, status, tags, and stage.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Holds information about a specific career role plan including skills, milestones, and compatibility.

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Enum for skill development status: 'Strong', 'Gap', or 'In progress'.

classes.name: MindMapSubNode
classes.description: Sub-node under a category in the mind map, representing specific skills or topics.

classes.name: MindMapCategory
classes.description: Category node in the mind map, containing related sub-nodes.

classes.name: MindMapNodeKind
classes.description: Type for different kinds of mind map nodes: 'you', 'category', or 'sub'.

classes.name: MindMapNode
classes.description: Representation of a node in the mind map with position, size, and tooltip info.

classes.name: MindMapEdge
classes.description: Connection between mind map nodes, possibly curved, with styling info.

methods.name: polarPoint
methods.description: Calculates an (x, y) point given a center, radius, and angle in degrees.

methods.name: mixToWhite
methods.description: Interpolates an RGB color toward white by a factor t.

methods.name: buildCategoriesForRole
methods.description: Generates category data and sub-nodes for the mind map based on role info.

methods.name: curvedPath
methods.description: Returns a SVG path string for a quadratic curve between two points.

methods.name: getMindMapModel
methods.description: Builds the full mind map model (nodes and edges) based on categories and layout parameters.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads roadmap state (active role and plans) from local storage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to local storage.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a mock RolePlan with preset milestones and skill deltas based on role ID.

methods.name: PathwayCareerTimeline
methods.description: React component for rendering a career pathway timeline with milestones and progress.

methods.name: ProgressRing
methods.description: Visual component showing milestone completion percentage with a ring UI.

methods.name: MilestoneCard
methods.description: UI card for individual milestones, with toggle for completion status.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: React hook to detect user prefers-reduced-motion setting for accessibility.

methods.name: useIntersectionReveal
methods.description: React hook for reveal animations on elements when they enter the viewport.

methods.name: RoadmapAmbientBackground
methods.description: Component for animated background effects used in the roadmap page.
